title: Evidence Receipt v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Independently observed acceptance fact for one criterion of one attempt, issued by an independent observer and consumed by the gate service. signature establishes provenance only, not artifact truth: semantic_checks records the artifact-specific checks actually run. A model-authored string is never accepted as reviewer attestation; the authenticated reviewer principal comes from the external authority, not from this wire record.

criterion_id.description: Required acceptance-criterion identifier. Missing criterion ids fail closed.

artifact_digest.description: Digest of the artifact judged; checked by the gate, not trusted from the receipt.

principal.description: Authenticated reviewer/observer principal, separate from the worker principal.

signature.description: Signature over the receipt. Establishes provenance, not artifact truth.

semantic_checks.description: Artifact-specific checks actually executed. A receipt without at least one check is not acceptance evidence.
